rules.description: Checks that the latest date is the same for all StatVars.
Verifies that all 18 StatVars are present and MaxDate is within the expected 3-year CDC release lag.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs = 18
